executive_summary: Based on your e-commerce support needs and Shopify stack, Intercom Fin is the strongest fit for automated ticket deflection while staying within your budget.

ranked_list.name: Intercom Fin
ranked_list.fit_reason: Native Shopify context and strong support automation for small teams.

ranked_list.name: Tidio Lyro
ranked_list.fit_reason: Lower cost entry point with solid chat automation for small stores.

why_top_pick: Matches your primary goal of reducing support ticket volume
Integrates with Shopify for order-aware responses
Fits a non-technical team with guided setup

cost_estimate.summary: Estimated ~$139/mo at your team size; confirm current pricing on vendor site.

implementation_steps.title: Connect Shopify
implementation_steps.description: Install the Intercom Shopify app and sync order/customer data.

implementation_steps.title: Configure Fin on top topics
implementation_steps.description: Train on order status, returns, and shipping FAQs first.

implementation_steps.title: Pilot and measure deflection
implementation_steps.description: Run for 2 weeks; track resolution rate and escalation quality.

migration_path: No migration required if starting fresh on Intercom.
If replacing a basic chat widget, export FAQ content into Fin training sources.
tradeoffs: Higher cost than lightweight chatbots at very small scale
Advanced customization may need admin time in first month

alternatives.name: Tidio Lyro
alternatives.choose_if: You need a lower monthly cost and can accept fewer enterprise support features.
